noise_rule: per-state differential complex data RMS; real and imaginary variance sigma^2/2
rom_construction: background tangents of eight fixed smooth full-grid complex material probes; all sources; leading current SVD32; no truth snapshots
tv_rule: lambda=0.01*(1+sigma/background_data_RMS); normalized data loss .5||W residual||^2/||W yb||^2; same physical prior in every arm
step_rule: 0.8/lambda_max(Jb^T Jb/||yb||^2) in real mass coordinates; single global fixed step per background
initialization: one common background linear-adjoint gradient step followed by the same constrained TV proximal

missing_baselines.SOM_FFT_TSOM: NOT_COMPARABLE: existing Gaussian-parameter fit changes material prior and optimizer

timing_conditions: weak/ring x first parent of each family x amplitude0.3 x20dB; three primary arms, fresh material caches each repeat
gate_aggregation: equal mean within parent over two backgrounds, two amplitudes and two noise levels; four parent clusters; preserve all failures and missing rows
full_residual_noise_budget: noisy increase vs F <= sqrt(m_real) in true noise-white coordinates; noiseless relative increase <=1e-10
closure_denominator_floor: max(actual noise norm,1e-12*background_data_norm); do not replace undefined ratio
confirmation_regime: known strong spherical ring background; one fixed shell and one asymmetric mask; amplitudes0.3/1.2; noiseless; L/F/R16 only
hash_policy: Git source commits and blob IDs; no new SHA256 checks; existing SHA256 fields are historical
